summary.text: Angelito Tenorio is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 14, where he took office on January 6, 2025, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election against Republican AmyRose Murphy.
A former educator and Army National Guard veteran, he previously served on the West Allis Common Council.

paragraphs.text: Angelito Tenorio was born in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, served in the Army National Guard from 2015 to 2018, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin-Madison in 2017.
His career experience includes working as an educator, and he has been affiliated with Wisconsin Conservation Voters.
Tenorio served on the West Allis Common Council from 2020 to 2022.
He joined the Assembly in January 2025 and for 2025-2026 was assigned to the Jobs and the Economy and the Veterans and Military Affairs committees.
